claims.statement: Let b(x,y)=1_A(y)g_y(x), where A is affine and every physical y-coordinate is transverse to A. If every Boolean fiber g_y satisfies H(g_y)<=C I(g_y), then Eraw(b)<=C I_x(b)+4 I_y(b)<=max(C,4)I(b).
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, affine shifts, codimensions, densities, fiber sign patterns and affine-label correlations; constant 4 on the transverse budget is sharp.

claims.statement: For affine label dimension d, codimension r and density p, the signed cylinder has Eraw(b)=2rp+pH(Q), with H(Q)<=2d+average_y H(g_y).
claims.scope: Exact coherent quotient-spectrum identity and dimension-free posterior payment; no orthogonality assumption.

claims.statement: Combining the affine collision theorem with the affine-cylinder lift gives Eraw(hb)<=H(F)+C I_T(b)+4 I_M(b) for Boolean overlap realizations F=a+hb in the stated class.
claims.scope: Restriction hereditary provided the fiber FEI class is restriction hereditary.

claims.statement: Affine supports now admit both a complete collision ledger and a source-influence payment with arbitrary internal coordinate fibers. Non-affine supports still need a boundary-paid gluing or joint activation theorem.
